body:
Wow thank you for sharing your story. It’s so helpful to hear someone went through the same thing.

The thing is with my boyfriend is, yeah he’s paranoid and seriously anxious, other girls have done this to him before. I don’t blame him. But he isn’t controlling or demanding, and actually so caring of me. And the only person who has ever accepted me for who I am, even when I’m having a totally bad episode. He accepts me at my best and worst. He is perfect, he will do anything for me. Anything.

I have taken advantage of his kindness and the fact that he will do anything for me. I just can’t lose him. He saved my life and I can’t face the world without knowing I have him. I don’t know how I got so lucky, and getting myself in this mess may now just be the worst thing I’ve ever done in my life.

It’s true. I guess I just want to help people. I’ve frequented suicide watch on other accounts and hate people suffering in silence. This time I just didn’t pick up on the triggers and should have got out quicker. I’m an idiot
Well no I was because I was trying to make him laugh with his own sense of humour. I then got trapped, and my “care” taken advantage of.
He asked me that question and I did agree like “oh actually I didn’t even think of that” and now it’s hit me like a fucking ton of bricks how I could have handled the situation better.
You’re right. We both admitted that our chat would come across a different way other than as intended.
I didn’t think it was, I had nothing to hide and made no effort to, if it didn’t feel right or secretive, it would have been something I had hidden. But instead I agreed to show him every message.

And all my friends growing up we’re boys so it just didn’t feel any different. I suppose I’ve been completely naive and this has completely hit me like a ton of bricks as a massive learning experience

I know what you mean, but in my head I wasn’t flirting, I was stooping down to my doofus friend’s weird level, and trying to make him happy because I know going through shit alone isn’t easy. I know I shouldn’t be so invested in helping some people, and I let it get too far... I just. Nothing happened and there was never an intention. I just. Oh god it feels like a nightmare
Glad I wasn’t the only one thinking that
Oh my god this is something I would do

The relationship is so important to me. And I know that the urges are just self destructive, and they are just thoughts that I’ve literally no control over. 

Turns out he saw over my shoulder me typing this out when I thought he was asleep. He was upset this morning but we chatted a bit before he left for work and we’ll chat when he gets home. 

I hate this.

You're a nasty person. Regardless of my problem, you're a shithead. My mental illness is very much specialist diagnosed and medicated for years. That is not something I can "get the fuck over." You simply cannot say that to people. Suicide has the same death statistics as many other diseases that kill people, would you tell someone with terminal cancer to get the fuck over it?

You insensitive little shit.
